//verify: Everything deterministic. Green before every commit and every review fire.
//verify:fast: Typecheck + lint only, for the per-file loop during generation.
//audit: Time-varying — dependency CVEs. Slice completion, before each gate, weekly. NEVER per file.

scripts.verify: npm run verify:types && npm run verify:lint && npm run verify:format && npm run verify:deadcode && npm run verify:sast && npm run verify:secrets
scripts.verify:fast: npm run verify:types && npm run verify:lint

//expo: Expo apps add expo-doctor to verify: "&& npx expo-doctor"
//semgrep: Pin the ruleset version once chosen. An auto-updating ruleset makes this check time-varying, and it then belongs in audit, not verify.
//fix: `fix` is a convenience for humans and agents mid-slice. It is never a substitute for reading what changed.
